state.title: State (2-letter)
state.description: Keep only reports from this state, e.g. AZ. Leave blank for every state.

dateFrom.title: From date (YYYY-MM-DD)
dateFrom.description: Keep only reports on or after this date. Blank means no lower bound.

dateTo.title: To date (YYYY-MM-DD)
dateTo.description: Keep only reports on or before this date. Blank means no upper bound.

naicsPrefix.title: Industry code prefix (NAICS)
naicsPrefix.description: Keep only reports whose industry code starts with this, e.g. 23 for construction.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Keep only reports whose text contains this word, e.g. amputation.

maxItems.title: Max reports
maxItems.description: Stop after this many reports. Hard ceiling is 1000, so a run cannot run away.

timeoutSeconds.title: Run timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: Stop collecting after this many seconds so a run cannot hang.
